camel_example: aliyun quickbi-public UpdateWorkspaceUserRole --region cn-hangzhou --UserId f5698bedeb384b1986afccd9e4340000 --WorkspaceId '95296e95-ca89-4c7d-8af9-dedf0ad00000' --version 2022-01-01 --method POST --force
description_en: Modifies the role of a specified member in a workspace. The existing role is overwritten
description_zh: 修改工作空间下指定成员的角色，已有的角色会被覆盖
name: UpdateWorkspaceUserRole

parameters.help_en:
The preset workspace role ID. The existing role is overwritten. Valid values:
25: workspace administrator
26: workspace developer
27: workspace analyst
30: workspace viewer
parameters.help_zh:
预置空间角色ID，已有角色会被覆盖。取值范围：
25：空间管理员
26：空间开发者
27：空间分析师
30：空间查看者
parameters.name: role_id

parameters.help_en:
Multiple workspace role IDs, separated by commas. If this parameter is specified, it takes precedence.
<notice>roleId and roleIds cannot both be empty></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
多个空间角色ID，以逗号分隔,如果传了该值，以该值为准。
<notice>roleId和roleIds不能同时为空></notice>
parameters.name: role_ids

Result.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values:

true: The operation succeeded.
false: The operation failed
Result.description_zh:
返回接口执行结果。取值范围：

false：执行失败
